name: expert_framework_enhanced
description: Enhanced set of expert privacy rules derived from GDPR, NIST, and Solove, designed to improve the focusing effect.
rules: If data is collected from minors (under 16), strict verifiable parental consent is required.
If location data is stored, it must be encrypted at rest and access must be logged.
If personal data is shared with third parties, a data processing agreement must be in place and the user must be informed.
If automated decision-making or profiling is used, the user must have the right to opt-out and receive a human review.
If a data breach occurs involving sensitive data, affected users must be notified within 72 hours.
If surveillance or monitoring technologies are used, clear and conspicuous notice must be provided before collection begins.
If data is aggregated from multiple sources to create profiles, the user must be informed of this profiling activity.
If sensitive data (health, biometric, financial) is collected, it requires explicit, affirmative consent (opt-in).
If data is used for a purpose other than what it was originally collected for (secondary use), new consent must be obtained.
If a user requests access to or deletion of their data, the organization must comply within a reasonable timeframe (e.g., 30 days).
